requirement.value: Fury or Prizefighter mastery (the Pilot route is cut)

system.description: Swords join Frenzy's crit list. With a two-handed sword equipped: spend an Opportunity for a free attack, +5 damage, generating no Opportunities (once per round). And when your two-handed sword costs creatures HP: spend 1 Fabula Point to reduce one non-Villain among them, whose HP are at or under your Crisis score, to 0.
